name: Traceability matrix
description: Generates a traceability matrix between the elements of two meta types of the model.

configStructure.name: traceabilityType
configStructure.description: Set (relation) used to compute the traceability links between the row and column elements.

configStructure.name: traceabilityRow
configStructure.description: Meta type of the elements shown as rows ("All" for every type).

configStructure.name: traceabilityColumn
configStructure.description: Meta type of the elements shown as columns ("All" for every type).
